newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Last Renault 5 rolls off Slovenian production line.
newsitem.headline: Last Renault 5 rolls off Slovenian production line.

text.p: Slovenian car producer Revoz, a subsidiary of France's Renault, said on Thursday the world's last Renault 5 rolled off its production line at the end of July.
For the past three years, Revoz has been the only factory to continue production of the 25-year old model.
The Slovenian company began production of the model in 1989 and produced a total 292,121 cars, of which about 84 percent were exported to the European Union.
Altogether, Renault produced 9.2 million Renault 5 cars over the past 25 years.
Production of the Renault 5 has been replaced with the Clio model -- Slovenia's best-selling car so far this year. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
